original_text: stacked analyses using IceCube \cite{PhysRevD.108.043001} data have shown that neutrino searches from dSphs can provide competitive constraints on the dark matter annihilation cross section for several leptonic channels.
injected_text: stacked analyses using IceCube \cite{PhysRevD.108.043001} data have shown that neutrino searches from dSphs can provide competitive constraints on the dark matter annihilation cross section.
rationale: The cited Guo et al. (PhysRevD.108.043001) study constrains the DM annihilation cross section only for several leptonic final states (specifically leptonic channels via IceCube tracks); dropping the 'for several leptonic channels' scope qualifier over-generalises the bound to all annihilation channels, while leaving the cite key, direction, and quantitative content untouched.
ground_truth_description: Removed the explicit scope qualifier 'for several leptonic channels' from the citing sentence so the cited IceCube/dSph constraint is asserted for the DM annihilation cross section in general, rather than only for the leptonic channels actually analysed.

truth.claim_sentence_verbatim: In particular, stacked analyses using IceCube \cite{PhysRevD.108.043001} data have shown that neutrino searches from dSphs can provide competitive constraints on the dark matter annihilation cross section for several leptonic channels.
